meta.name: security-audit
meta.description: Deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency vulnerabilities, and secrets scanning. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码中的安全漏洞与配置风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在发布前发现并修复安全漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Scan code for security vulnerabilities and configuration risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and fix security vulnerabilities before release.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会调用 Centinela (QA) 代理做安全审计:检查 OWASP Top 10、扫描硬编码密钥、审计依赖 CVE,给出 APPROVED 或 CHANGES REQUIRED 结论。它只记录问题,不修漏洞。
howto.when: 发布前核查安全、改动认证/授权或数据处理的代码之后、以及周期性的代码库安全复查时会触发;也可直接输入 /security-audit 手动运行。

say.note: 审计整个 src/ 目录并输出报告
付款模块的审计报告写入 docs/reviews/

howto.what_en: Claude runs a deep security audit via the Centinela (QA) agent: OWASP Top 10 checks, secrets and dependency CVE scans, then an APPROVED or CHANGES REQUIRED verdict. It documents issues, never fixes them.
howto.when_en: Triggers before a release, after changes to authentication, authorization, or data handling, and for periodic codebase security reviews; you can also run /security-audit manually.

say_en.note: Audits the whole src/ directory and writes a report
Writes the payments report under docs/reviews/
